mapper.sql: id, run_code, workflow_id, company_id, trigger_type, trigger_source, status, input_params, output_result, error_message, step_logs, token_used, cost, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_agent_workflow_run ( run_code, workflow_id, company_id, trigger_type, trigger_source, status, input_params, start_time, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{runCode}, #{workflowId}, #{companyId}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerSource}, #{status}, #{inputParams}, #{startTime}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM opc_agent_workflow_run r WHERE r.workflow_id = (SELECT w.id FROM opc_agent_workflow w WHERE w.workflow_code = #{workflowCode}) AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.create_time >= #{since} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1
